gloss: exceptional; unusual; out of the ordinary

definitions.gloss: exceptional; unusual; out of the ordinary
definitions.explanation: Deviating from the norm or standard rule. Describes something that is an exception to the general pattern.

examples.japanese: これは{例外的|れいがいてき}なケースだ。
{例外的|れいがいてき}に{許可|きょか}された。
examples.english: It was permitted as an exception.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}は{例外的|れいがいてき}な{措置|そち}として、{締|し}め{切|き}りを{延長|えんちょう}します。
examples.english: As an exceptional measure, we will extend the deadline this time.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from {例外|れいがい} (exception) + {的|てき} (suffix making a na-adjective). Describes something that does not follow the usual rule or pattern.

USAGE:
- As a modifier: {例外的|れいがいてき}な + noun (e.g., {例外的|れいがいてき}な{扱|あつか}い: exceptional treatment)
- As an adverb: {例外的|れいがいてき}に (exceptionally, as an exception)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {例外的|れいがいてき}な{措置|そち}: exceptional measure
- {例外的|れいがいてき}な{扱|あつか}い: exceptional treatment
- {例外的|れいがいてき}なケース: exceptional case
- {例外的|れいがいてき}に{認|みと}める: to approve as an exception

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特別|とくべつ}: special — broader meaning, not necessarily about breaking a rule
- {異例|いれい}: unprecedented, unusual — emphasizes rarity and deviation from custom
- {特殊|とくしゅ}: special, peculiar — emphasizes uniqueness of a specific situation
